decidedBy: the lead, 2026-10-07, on the project owner's instruction to withdraw Haggedolim and Beno unless the Hebrew and the Septuagint show a man, read against BHSA, Brenton's Septuagint and the King James
policy: Where a dataset's record headed by a word that is no name is withdrawn, what the text says of the man the word stood beside is said on his own record.
source: Essenthos, on the project owner's instruction of 2026-10-07 on Haggedolim and Beno, read against the Hebrew and the Septuagint

says.notes: The son of one of the great men (NEH 11:14); the text does not give his father's name.

rulings.why: 'and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of one of the great men': בֶּן הַגְּדוֹלִים has the article and a plural, and Brenton's Septuagint reads υἱὸς τῶν μεγάλων.
